title: search_files
description: Find files based on metadata or content

query.description: Search query string — use specific filenames or content keywords, NOT the full natural-language prompt

extensions.description: File extensions to filter by (without leading dot). Example: ["pdf", "docx", "txt"]

folder_hint.description: Preferred folder name to search in first. Example: "downloads", "documents", "desktop"

mode.description: Search strategy mode: auto merges all tiers, fast prioritizes low latency, deep prioritizes recall.

time_budget_ms.description: Maximum latency budget for this query before returning best-effort results.

continuation_token.description: Opaque token from previous results to continue deep scanning.

include_hidden.description: Whether hidden files and directories should be included.

max_depth.description: Optional maximum directory depth relative to each scanned root.
